title: Toward Trustworthy Digital Twins in AI Agent-based Wireless Network Optimization: Challenges, Solutions, and Opportunities
summary: Optimizing modern wireless networks is exceptionally challenging due to their high dynamism and complexity. While the AI agent powered by reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising solution, its practical application is limited by prohibitive exploration costs and potential risks in the real world. The emerging digital twin (DT) technology provides a safe and controlled virtual environment for agent training, but its effectiveness critically depends on the DT's reliability. Policies trained in an unreliable DT that does not accurately represent the physical network may experience severe performance degradation upon real-world deployment. In this article, we introduce a new DT evaluation framework to ensure trustworthy DTs in AI agent-based network optimization. This framework shifts from model-level accuracy, such as wireless channel and user trajectory similarities, to a more holistic, task-centric DT assessment, which relies on the Markov decision process that the agent actually perceives. We demonstrate it as an effective guideline for design, selection, and lifecycle management of wireless network DTs. A comprehensive case study on a real-world wireless network testbed shows how this evaluation framework is used to pre-filter candidate DTs, leading to a significant reduction in training and testing costs without sacrificing deployment performance. Finally, potential research opportunities are discussed.

title: High entropy leads to symmetry-equivariant policies in Dec-POMDPs
summary: We prove that in any Dec-POMDP, sufficiently high entropy regularization ensures that the policy gradient flow with tabular softmax parametrization always converges, for any initialization, to the same joint policy, and that this joint policy is equivariant w.r.t. all symmetries of the Dec-POMDP. In particular, policies coming from different initializations will be fully compatible, in that their cross-play returns are equal to their self-play returns. Through extensive evaluation of independent PPO, arguably the standard baseline deep multi-agent policy gradient algorithm, in the Hanabi, Overcooked and Yokai environments, we find that the entropy coefficient has a massive influence on the cross-play returns between independently trained policies, and that the decrease in self-play returns coming from increased entropy regularization can often be counteracted by greedifying the learned policies after training. In Hanabi in particular we achieve a new SOTA in inter-seed cross-play this way. While we give examples of Dec-POMDPs in which one cannot learn the optimal symmetry-equivariant policy this way, both our theoretical and empirical results suggest that one should consider far higher entropy coefficients during hyperparameter sweeps in Dec-POMDPs than is typically done. Code for our experiments can be found at https://github.com/jforkel/JAX-OBL

title: Cross-Domain Federated Semantic Communication with Global Representation Alignment and Domain-Aware Aggregation
summary: Semantic communication can significantly improve bandwidth utilization in wireless systems by exploiting the meaning behind raw data. However, the advancements achieved through semantic communication are closely dependent on the development of deep learning (DL) models for joint source-channel coding (JSCC) encoder/decoder techniques, which require a large amount of data for training. To address this data-intensive nature of DL models, federated learning (FL) has been proposed to train a model in a distributed manner, where the server broadcasts the DL model to clients in the network for training with their local data. However, the conventional FL approaches suffer from catastrophic degradation when client data are from different domains. In contrast, in this paper, a novel FL framework is proposed to address this domain shift by constructing the global representation, which aligns with the local features of the clients to preserve the semantics of different data domains. In addition, the dominance problem of client domains with a large number of samples is identified and, then, addressed with a domain-aware aggregation approach. This work is the first to consider the domain shift in training the semantic communication system for the image reconstruction task. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms the model-contrastive FL (MOON) framework by 0.5 for PSNR values under three domains at an SNR of 1 dB, and this gap continues to widen as the channel quality improves.

title: Audio-Visual World Models: Grounding Multisensory Imagination for Embodied Agents
summary: World models simulate environmental dynamics to enable agents to plan and reason about future states. While existing approaches have primarily focused on visual observations, real-world perception inherently involves multiple sensory modalities. Audio provides crucial spatial and temporal cues such as sound source localization and acoustic scene properties, yet its integration into world models remains relatively underexplored. Prior work has not established a commonly adopted formulation for audio-visual world modeling under low-level action control or clarified how to jointly capture physically grounded binaural audio and visual dynamics. This work presents a unified formulation of Audio-Visual World Models (AVWM), casting multimodal environment simulation as a partially observable Markov decision process with synchronized audio-visual observations. As a foundational step toward this problem, we construct AVW-4k, a controlled benchmark comprising 30 hours of binaural audio-visual trajectories with action annotations across 76 indoor environments. We propose AV-CDiT, an Audio-Visual Conditional Diffusion Transformer with a novel modality expert architecture that balances visual and auditory learning, optimized through a three-stage training strategy for effective multimodal integration. Extensive experiments on this benchmark demonstrate that AV-CDiT achieves high-fidelity multimodal prediction across visual and auditory modalities. Furthermore, we validate its practical utility in embodied navigation, demonstrating that AVWM improves a vision-language-model-guided agent in continuous audio-visual navigation.

title: Directed evolution algorithm drives neural prediction
summary: Neural prediction offers a promising approach to forecasting the individual variability of neurocognitive functions and disorders and providing prognostic indicators for personalized invention. However, it is challenging to translate neural predictive models into medical artificial intelligent applications due to the limitations of domain shift and label scarcity. Here, we propose the directed evolution model (DEM), a novel computational model that mimics the trial-and-error processes of biological directed evolution to approximate optimal solutions for predictive modeling tasks. We demonstrated that the directed evolution algorithm is an effective strategy for uncertainty exploration, enhancing generalization in reinforcement learning. Furthermore, by incorporating replay buffer and continual backpropagate methods into DEM, we provide evidence of achieving better trade-off between exploitation and exploration in continuous learning settings. We conducted experiments on four different datasets for children with cochlear implants whose spoken language developmental outcomes vary considerably on the individual-child level. Preoperative neural MRI data has shown to accurately predict the post-operative outcome of these children within but not across datasets. Our results show that DEM can efficiently improve the performance of cross-domain pre-implantation neural predictions while addressing the challenge of label scarcity in target domain.

title: Measuring Agents in Production
comments: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as Oral Presentation
summary: LLM-based agents already operate in production across many industries, yet we lack an understanding of what technical methods make deployments successful. We present the first systematic study of Measuring Agents in Production, MAP, using first-hand data from agent developers. We conducted 20 case studies via in-depth interviews and surveyed 86 deployed systems practitioners across 26 domains. We investigate why organizations build agents, how they build them, how they evaluate them, and their top development challenges. Our study finds that production agents are built using simple, controllable approaches: 68% execute at most 10 steps before human intervention, 70% rely on prompting off-the-shelf models instead of weight tuning, and 74% depend primarily on human evaluation. Reliability (consistent correct behavior over time) remains the top development challenge, which practitioners currently address through systems-level design. MAP documents the current state of production agents, providing the research community with visibility into deployment realities and underexplored research avenues.
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as Oral Presentation

title: Rotatable Antenna-Enhanced Cell-Free Communication
summary: Rotatable antenna (RA) is a promising technology that can exploit new spatial degrees-of-freedom (DoFs) by flexibly adjusting the three-dimensional (3D) boresight direction of antennas. In this letter, we investigate an RA-enhanced cell-free system for downlink transmission, where multiple RA-equipped access points (APs) cooperatively serve multiple single-antenna users over the same time-frequency resource. Specifically, we aim to maximize the sum rate of all users by jointly optimizing the AP-user associations and the RA boresight directions. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage strategy to solve the AP-user association problem, and then employ fractional programming (FP) and successive convex approximation (SCA) techniques to optimize the RA boresight directions. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed RA-enhanced cell-free system significantly outperforms various benchmark schemes.

title: Ask Safely: Privacy-Aware LLM Query Generation for Knowledge Graphs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to query knowledge graphs (KGs) due to their strong semantic understanding and extrapolation capabilities compared to traditional approaches. However, when KGs contain sensitive information and users lack local access to generative models, privacy becomes a critical concern. To address this issue, we propose a privacy-aware query generation approach for KGs. Our method identifies sensitive information in the graph based on its structure and omits such values before requesting the LLM to translate natural language questions into Cypher queries. Experimental results show that our approach effectively prevents sensitive data from being transmitted to third-party services, while maintaining a high level of query accuracy.

title: SHAP-Guided Kernel Actor-Critic for Explainable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Actor-critic (AC) methods are a cornerstone of reinforcement learning (RL) but offer limited interpretability. Current explainable RL methods seldom use state attributions to assist training. Rather, they treat all state features equally, thereby neglecting the heterogeneous impacts of individual state dimensions on the reward. We propose RKHS-SHAP-based Advanced Actor-Critic (RSA2C), an attribution-aware, kernelized, two-timescale AC algorithm, including Actor, Value Critic, and Advantage Critic. The Actor is instantiated in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with a Mahalanobis-weighted operator-valued kernel, while the Value Critic and Advantage Critic reside in scalar RKHSs. These RKHS-enhanced components use sparsified dictionaries: the Value Critic maintains its own dictionary, while the Actor and Advantage Critic share one. State attributions, computed from the Value Critic via RKHS-SHAP (kernel mean embedding for on-manifold and conditional mean embedding for off-manifold expectations), are converted into Mahalanobis-gated weights that modulate Actor gradients and Advantage Critic targets. We derive a global, non-asymptotic convergence bound under state perturbations, showing stability through the perturbation-error term and efficiency through the convergence-error term. Empirical results on three continuous-control environments show that RSA2C achieves efficiency, stability, and interpretability. Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/RSA2C.

title: Off-grid solar energy storage system with hybrid lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lead-acid batteries in high mountains: a case report of Jiujiu Cabins in Taiwan
summary: Mountain huts are buildings located at high altitude, offering a place for hikers and providing shelter. Energy supply on mountain huts is still an open issue. Using renewable energies could be an appropriate solution. Jiujiu Cabins, a famous mountain hut in Shei-Pa National Park, Taiwan, has operated an off-grid solar energy storage system (ESS) with lead-acid batteries. In 2021, a serious system failure took place, leading to no electricity. After a detailed on-site survey, a reorganization and repair project implemented, the energy system came back to operate normally. Meanwhile, an eco-friendly lithium iron phosphate battery (LFP battery) ESS replaces part of the lead-acid battery ESS, forming a hybrid ESS, making a better and green off-grid solar ESS. In this case report, the energy architecture, detailed descriptions, and historical status of the system are provided. An on-site survey of the failed energy system, a system improvement project, and future plan are listed.

title: GS-KAN: Parameter-Efficient Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks via Sprecher-Type Shared Basis Functions
summary: The Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem offers a theoretical alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) by placing learnable univariate functions on edges rather than nodes. While recent implementations such as Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) demonstrate high approximation capabilities, they suffer from significant parameter inefficiency due to the requirement of maintaining unique parameterizations for every network edge. In this work, we propose GS-KAN (Generalized Sprecher-KAN), a lightweight architecture inspired by David Sprecher's refinement of the superposition theorem. GS-KAN constructs unique edge functions by applying learnable linear transformations to a single learnable, shared parent function per layer. We evaluate GS-KAN against existing KAN architectures and MLPs across synthetic function approximation, tabular data regression and image classification tasks. Our results demonstrate that GS-KAN outperforms both MLPs and standard KAN baselines on continuous function approximation tasks while maintaining superior parameter efficiency. Additionally, GS-KAN achieves competitive performance with existing KAN architectures on tabular regression and outperforms MLPs on high-dimensional classification tasks. Crucially, the proposed architecture enables the deployment of KAN-based architectures in high-dimensional regimes under strict parameter constraints, a setting where standard implementations are typically infeasible due to parameter explosion. The source code is available at https://github.com/rambamn48/gs-impl.

title: Creation of the Estonian Subjectivity Dataset: Assessing the Degree of Subjectivity on a Scale
summary: This article presents the creation of an Estonian-language dataset for document-level subjectivity, analyzes the resulting annotations, and reports an initial experiment of automatic subjectivity analysis using a large language model (LLM). The dataset comprises of 1,000 documents-300 journalistic articles and 700 randomly selected web texts-each rated for subjectivity on a continuous scale from 0 (fully objective) to 100 (fully subjective) by four annotators. As the inter-annotator correlations were moderate, with some texts receiving scores at the opposite ends of the scale, a subset of texts with the most divergent scores was re-annotated, with the inter-annotator correlation improving. In addition to human annotations, the dataset includes scores generated by GPT-5 as an experiment on annotation automation. These scores were similar to human annotators, however several differences emerged, suggesting that while LLM based automatic subjectivity scoring is feasible, it is not an interchangeable alternative to human annotation, and its suitability depends on the intended application.

title: Take a Peek: Efficient Encoder Adaptation for Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation via LoRA
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) aims to segment novel classes in query images using only a small annotated support set. While prior research has mainly focused on improving decoders, the encoder's limited ability to extract meaningful features for unseen classes remains a key bottleneck. In this work, we introduce \textit{Take a Peek} (TaP), a simple yet effective method that enhances encoder adaptability for both FSS and cross-domain FSS \rev{by inducing a lightweight \textit{feature-space shift} conditioned on the support set}. TaP leverages Low-Rank Adaptation to fine-tune the encoder on the support set with minimal computational overhead, enabling fast adaptation to novel classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing FSS pipelines. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks--including COCO $20^i$, Pascal $5^i$, and cross-domain datasets such as DeepGlobe, ISIC, and Chest X-ray--demonstrate that TaP consistently improves segmentation performance across diverse models and shot settings. Notably, TaP delivers significant gains in complex multi-class scenarios, highlighting its practical effectiveness in realistic settings. A rank sensitivity analysis also shows that strong performance can be achieved even with low-rank adaptations, thereby ensuring computational efficiency. By addressing a critical limitation in FSS--the encoder's generalization to novel classes--TaP paves the way toward more robust, efficient, and generalizable segmentation systems. The code is available at https://github.com/pasqualedem/TakeAPeek.

title: Calibrating Uncertainty for Zero-Shot Adversarial CLIP
summary: CLIP delivers strong zero-shot classification but remains highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Prior adversarial fine-tuning work primarily matches predicted logits between clean and adversarial examples, which overlooks uncertainty calibration and may degrade the zero-shot generalization. A common expectation in reliable uncertainty estimation is that predictive uncertainty should increase as inputs become more difficult or shift away from the training distribution. However, we frequently observe the opposite in the adversarial setting: perturbations not only degrade accuracy but also suppress uncertainty, leading to severe miscalibration and over-confidence. This reveals a critical reliability gap beyond robustness. To bridge this gap, we propose an adversarial fine-tuning objective for CLIP considering both accuracy and uncertainty. By reparameterizing CLIP outputs as the concentration parameters of a Dirichlet distribution, we propose a unified representation that captures relative semantic structure and confidence magnitude. This enables holistic distribution alignment under perturbations, moving beyond single-logit anchoring and restoring calibrated uncertainty. Experiments across multiple zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves uncertainty calibration and achieves competitive adversarial robustness while preserving clean accuracy.

title: A geometric $q$-analogue of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
summary: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) generates efficient Markov transitions by combining Hamiltonian dynamics with a Metropolis correction. This paper develops a geometric \(q\)-analogue of HMC by replacing classical Hamiltonian dynamics with a \(q\)-deformed Hamiltonian system arising from \(q\)-calculus. Starting from a Lagrangian formulation, we derive the corresponding \(q\)-Hamiltonian equations and prove the formal invariance of the associated \(q\)-symplectic form within the \(q\)-deformed differential calculus. To obtain a computable sampler, we introduce a Jackson-derivative realization and construct a Metropolis-corrected \(q\)-HMC algorithm. The proposal reduces to classical HMC as \(q\to1\), while for \(q\neq1\) it replaces ordinary derivatives by \(q\)-Jackson finite differences. We establish detailed balance, which ensures that the resulting Markov transition preserves the target distribution. Numerical experiments examine the computational behavior of the proposed method. For positive-scale black-box targets, the \(q\)-Jackson force has a scale-consistent interpretation: multiplicative perturbations of \(s>0\) correspond to centered finite differences in \(y=\log s\). In such examples, \(q\)-HMC closely tracks log-coordinate finite-difference HMC and the exact-gradient benchmark, whereas raw additive finite differences may produce large force and Hamiltonian errors. These results suggest that the proposed \(q\)-analogue provides a valid HMC-type sampling framework with a visible advantage for positive and multiplicative black-box targets.

title: AutoTool: Dynamic Tool Selection and Integration for Agentic Reasoning
comments: ICML2026; Best Paper Award at ICCV 2025 Workshop on Multi-Modal Reasoning for Agentic Intelligence
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning has advanced large language models (LLMs) to reason through long chain-of-thought trajectories while interleaving external tool use. Existing approaches assume a fixed inventory of tools, which limits the adaptability of LLM agents to new or evolving toolsets. We present AutoTool, a training framework that equips LLM agents with dynamic tool-selection capabilities throughout their reasoning trajectories. AutoTool employs a dual-phase optimization pipeline: (i) SFT and RL-based trajectory stabilization for coherent reasoning, and (ii) KL-regularized Plackett-Luce Ranking to refine consistent multi-step tool selection. We further build a 200k dataset with explicit tool-selection rationales across 1,000+ tools and 100+ tasks spanning mathematics, science, code generation, and multimodal reasoning. Across ten diverse benchmarks, we train two base models, Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, with AutoTool. With fewer parameters, AutoTool consistently outperforms advanced LLM agents and tool-integration methods, yielding average gains of 6.4% in math & science reasoning, 4.5% in search-based QA, 7.7% in code generation, and 6.9% in multimodal understanding. In addition, AutoTool exhibits stronger generalization by dynamically leveraging unseen tools from evolving toolsets during inference.
comment: ICML2026; Best Paper Award at ICCV 2025 Workshop on Multi-Modal Reasoning for Agentic Intelligence

title: RePo: Language Models with Context Re-Positioning
summary: In-context learning is fundamental to modern Large Language Models (LLMs); however, prevailing architectures impose a rigid and fixed contextual structure by assigning linear or constant positional indices. The rigid position information poses the full burden of organizing the input structure to attention layers, thus reducing the amount of attention that could be allocated for more critical information. To address this, we propose RePo, a novel mechanism that alleviates the burden for attention layers via context re-positioning. Unlike conventional approaches, RePo utilizes a differentiable module, $f_φ$, to assign token positions that capture contextual dependencies, rather than replying on pre-defined order. By continually pre-training on the OLMo-2 1B \& 7B models, we demonstrate that RePo consistently enhances performance on tasks involving noisy contexts, structured data, and longer context length, while maintaining competitive performance on general short-context tasks. Analysis reveals that RePo successfully allocates more attention mass to distant but relevant information, assigns positions in a dense and non-linear space, and captures the intrinsic structure of the input context. Our code is at https://github.com/SakanaAI/repo.

title: Universal consistency of the $k$-NN rule in metric spaces and Nagata dimension. III
comments: 22 pages, latex with ESAIM P&S macros, a second revision requested by the referee, with more accurate and detailed proofs, in particular, the referee pointed out the correct value of the Nagata dimension of R^2 which is 4
summary:
We establish the last missing link allowing to describe those complete separable metric spaces $X$ in which the $k$ nearest neighbour classifier is universally consistent, both in combinatorial terms of dimension theory and via a fundamental property of real analysis. The following are equivalent: (1) The $k$-nearest neighbour classifier is universally consistent in $X$, (2) The strong Lebesgue--Besicovitch differentiation property holds in $X$ for every locally finite Borel measure, (3) $X$ is sigma-finite dimensional in the sense of Jun-Iti Nagata.
  The equivalence (2)$\iff$(3) was announced by Preiss (1983), while a detailed proof of the implication (3)$\Rightarrow$(2) has only appeared in Assouad and Quentin de Gromard (2006). The implication (2)$\Rightarrow$(1) was established by Cérou and Guyader (2006). We prove the implication (1)$\Rightarrow$(3). We further show that the weak (instead of strong) Lebesgue--Besicovitch property is insufficient for the consistency of the $k$-NN rule, as witnessed, for example, by the Heisenberg group (here we correct a wrong claim made in the previous article (Kumari and Pestov 2024)). A bit counter-intuitively, there is a metric on the real line uniformly equivalent to the usual distance but under which the $k$-NN classifier fails. Finally, another equivalent condition that can be added to the above is the Cover--Hart property: (4) the error of the $1$-nearest neighbour classifier is asymptotically at most twice as bad as the Bayes error.
comment: 22 pages, latex with ESAIM P&S macros, a second revision requested by the referee, with more accurate and detailed proofs, in particular, the referee pointed out the correct value of the Nagata dimension of R^2 which is 4

title: Detecting Flakiness in Quantum Software: A Dynamic Testing Approach
comments: Improved detection robustness and added root-cause & fix-pattern analysis
summary:
Flaky tests, tests that pass or fail nondeterministically without changes to code or environment, pose a serious threat to software reliability. While classical software engineering has developed a rich body of techniques to study flakiness, corresponding evidence for quantum software remains limited. Prior work relies mainly on static analysis or small sets of manually reported incidents, leaving open questions about their prevalence, characteristics, and detectability.
  This paper presents the first large-scale dynamic characterization of flaky tests in quantum software, focusing on the Qiskit Terra core library. We executed the Qiskit Terra test suite 10,000 times across 23 releases in controlled environments. For each release, we measured test-outcome variability, identified flaky tests, estimated empirical failure probabilities, analyzed recurrence across versions, used Wilson confidence intervals to quantify rerun budgets for reliable detection, and mapped flaky tests to Terra subcomponents.
  Across 27,026 fully qualified test identifiers, we identified 62 unique flaky tests. Although overall flakiness rates were low (0-0.17%), recurrence was substantial: 52 of 62 flaky tests (83.87%) reappeared in multiple releases, while only 10 tests (16.13%) were confined to a single release. Empirical failure probabilities spanned several orders of magnitude, with a median of $9 \times 10^{-4}$ and 34 tests (54.84%) at or below $10^{-3}$, implying that thousands to tens of thousands of executions may be required for confident detection.
  These results show that quantum test flakiness is rare but difficult to detect under typical continuous integration budgets. To support future research, we release a public dataset of per-test execution outcomes.
comment: Improved detection robustness and added root-cause & fix-pattern analysis

title: Generalization of Diffusion Models Arises with a Balanced Representation Space
comments: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 40 pages, 19 figures. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion models excel at generating high-quality, diverse samples, yet they risk memorizing training data when overfit to the training objective. We analyze the distinctions between memorization and generalization in diffusion models through the lens of representation learning. By investigating a two-layer ReLU denoising autoencoder (DAE), we prove that (i) memorization corresponds to the model storing raw training samples in the learned weights for encoding and decoding, yielding localized spiky representations, whereas (ii) generalization arises when the model captures local data statistics, producing balanced representations. Furthermore, we validate these theoretical findings on real-world unconditional and text-to-image diffusion models, demonstrating that the same representation structures emerge in deep generative models with significant practical implications. Building on these insights, we propose a representation-based method for detecting memorization and a training-free editing technique that allows precise control via representation steering. Together, our results highlight that learning good representations is central to novel and meaningful generative modeling.
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 40 pages, 19 figures. The first two authors contributed equally

title: It's a TRAP! Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark for Web Agents
summary: Web-based agents powered by large language models are increasingly used for tasks such as email management or professional networking. Their reliance on dynamic web content, however, makes them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks: adversarial instructions hidden in interface elements that persuade the agent to divert from its original task. We introduce the Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark (TRAP), a benchmark for studying how persuasion techniques misguide autonomous web agents on realistic tasks. Across six frontier models, agents are susceptible to prompt injection in 25% of tasks on average (13% for GPT-5 to 43% for DeepSeek-R1), with small interface or contextual changes often doubling success rates and revealing systemic, psychologically driven vulnerabilities in web-based agents. We also provide a modular social-engineering injection framework with controlled experiments on high-fidelity website clones, allowing for further benchmark expansion.

title: Agentic Physical AI toward a Domain-Specific Foundation Model for Energy Systems: A Case Study on Nuclear Reactor Control
summary: The prevailing paradigm in AI for physical systems: scaling general-purpose foundation models toward universal multimodal reasoning, confronts a barrier at the control interface. Frontier vision-language models achieve only 50-53% accuracy on basic quantitative physics tasks, behaving as approximate guessers that preserve semantic plausibility while violating physical constraints. Safety-critical control demands outcome-space guarantees over executed actions, not parameter-space imitation. Here we present a pathway toward domain-specific foundation models through compact language models operating as Agentic Physical AI: policy optimization driven by physics-based simulator validation rather than perceptual inference. We train a 360M-parameter model on synthetic nuclear reactor scenarios scaled from 10^3 to 10^5 examples. Scaling produces strong, regime-dependent reliability gains under nominal simulated conditions, with variance collapse of approximately 500x and elimination of >10% terminal-power excursions on the sampled distribution. Despite balanced exposure to four actuation families, the model concentrates 95% of runtime execution on a single-bank strategy, without reinforcement learning or reward engineering. Representations transfer across simulators without architectural change. We position the system as a candidate decision component within a verification, monitoring, and defense-in-depth architecture, not as a stand-alone safety solution: the demonstrated behavior speaks to closed-loop reliability on a single-step task in simulation and does not yet address off-nominal operation, sensor faults, or uncertainty quantification.

title: Agentic AI-Enhanced Semantic Communications: Foundations, Architecture, and Applications
comments: This version is being withdrawn because we need to further reevaluate the attribution of contributions among the authors
summary: Semantic communications (SemCom), as one of the key technologies for 6G, is shifting networks from bit transmission to semantic information exchange. On this basis, introducing agentic artificial intelligence (AI) with perception, memory, reasoning, and action capabilities provides a practicable path to intelligent communications. This paper provides a systematic exposition of how agentic AI empowers SemCom from the perspectives of research foundations, system architecture, and application scenarios. We first provide a comprehensive review of existing studies by agent types, covering embedded agents, large language model (LLM)/large vision model (LVM) agents, and reinforcement learning (RL) agents. Additionally, we propose a unified agentic AI-enhanced SemCom framework covering the application layer, the semantic layer, and the cloud-edge collaboration layer, forming a closed loop from intent to encoding to transmission to decoding to action to evaluation. We also present several typical scenarios, including multi-vehicle collaborative perception, multi-robot cooperative rescue, and agentic operations for intellicise (intelligent and concise) networks. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic knowledge base (KB)-based joint source-channel coding case study, AKB-JSCC, where the source KB and channel KB are built by LLM/LVM agents and RL agents, respectively. Experimental results show that AKB-JSCC achieves higher information reconstruction quality under different channel conditions. Finally, we discuss future evolution and research directions, providing a reference for portable, verifiable, and controllable research and deployment of agentic SemCom.

title: Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector for Stabilizing Latent Diffusion Inverse Problem Solvers
summary: While latent diffusion models (LDMs) have emerged as powerful priors for inverse problems, existing LDM-based solvers frequently suffer from instability. In this work, we first identify the instability as a discrepancy between the solver dynamics and stable reverse diffusion dynamics learned by the diffusion model, and show that reducing this gap stabilizes the solver. Building on this, we introduce \textit{Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector (MCLC)}, a theoretically grounded plug-and-play stabilization module that remedies the LDM-based inverse problem solvers through measurement-consistent Langevin updates. Compared to prior approaches that rely on linear manifold assumptions, which often fail to hold in latent space, MCLC provides a principled stabilization mechanism, leading to more stable and reliable behavior in latent space.

title: CHDP: Cooperative Hybrid Diffusion Policies for Reinforcement Learning in Parameterized Action Space
summary: Hybrid action space, which combines discrete choices and continuous parameters, is prevalent in domains such as robot control and game AI. However, efficiently modeling and optimizing hybrid discrete-continuous action space remains a fundamental challenge, mainly due to limited policy expressiveness and poor scalability in high-dimensional settings. To address this challenge, we view the hybrid action space problem as a fully cooperative game and propose a \textbf{Cooperative Hybrid Diffusion Policies (CHDP)} framework to solve it. CHDP employs two cooperative agents that leverage a discrete and a continuous diffusion policy, respectively. The continuous policy is conditioned on the discrete action's representation, explicitly modeling the dependency between them. This cooperative design allows the diffusion policies to leverage their expressiveness to capture complex distributions in their respective action spaces. To mitigate the update conflicts arising from simultaneous policy updates in this cooperative setting, we employ a sequential update scheme that fosters co-adaptation. Moreover, to improve scalability when learning in high-dimensional discrete action space, we construct a codebook that embeds the action space into a low-dimensional latent space. This mapping enables the discrete policy to learn in a compact, structured space. Finally, we design a Q-function-based guidance mechanism to align the codebook's embeddings with the discrete policy's representation during training. On challenging hybrid action benchmarks, CHDP outperforms the state-of-the-art method by up to $19.3\%$ in success rate.

AI.title_translation: CHDP：参数化动作空间中强化学习的协同混合扩散策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出CHDP框架，将混合动作空间强化学习视为完全合作博弈，通过协同离散与连续扩散策略、顺序更新、码本降维及Q函数引导，在混合动作基准测试中将成功率提升了高达19.3%。
AI.motivation: 在机器人控制和游戏AI等领域，混合动作空间（结合离散选择和连续参数）非常普遍。然而，由于现有策略的表达能力有限以及在高维设置下扩展性较差，如何高效地建模和优化混合动作空间仍然是一个根本性的挑战。
AI.method:
1. 提出CHDP框架，将混合动作空间问题建模为完全合作博弈，使用离散和连续两个协同扩散策略智能体。
2. 将连续策略以离散动作的表示为条件进行建模，显式捕捉两者间的依赖关系。
3. 采用顺序更新方案（sequential update scheme）来缓解同时更新策略时的冲突。
4. 构建码本（codebook）将高维离散动作空间嵌入低维潜在空间，提高扩展性。
5. 设计基于Q函数的引导机制，在训练中将码本嵌入与离散策略表示进行对齐。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的混合动作基准测试中，CHDP框架表现优异，其成功率相比最先进（SOTA）的方法提升了高达19.3%。
AI.conclusion: CHDP通过将混合动作空间问题建模为合作博弈，并结合协同扩散策略、顺序更新、低维码本嵌入及Q函数引导，成功解决了混合动作空间中强化学习的建模与扩展性瓶颈，显著提升了决策性能。
AI.translation: 混合动作空间结合了离散选择和连续参数，在机器人控制和游戏AI等领域非常普遍。然而，由于策略表达能力有限以及在高维设置中的扩展性较差，高效地建模和优化混合离散-连续动作空间仍然是一个根本性的挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们将混合动作空间问题视为一个完全合作博弈，并提出了一种合作混合扩散策略（CHDP）框架来解决它。CHDP采用了两个协同智能体，分别利用离散和连续扩散策略。连续策略以离散动作的表示为条件，从而显式地建模它们之间的依赖关系。这种协同设计使扩散策略能够利用其表达能力来捕获各自动作空间中的复杂分布。为了缓解在协同设置中同时更新策略所带来的更新冲突，我们采用了一种促进共同适应的顺序更新方案。此外，为了提高在高维离散动作空间中学习时的扩展性，我们构建了一个码本，将动作空间嵌入到低维潜在空间中。这种映射使离散策略能够在紧凑、结构化的空间中进行学习。最后，我们设计了一种基于Q函数的引导机制，以在训练期间将码本的嵌入与离散策略的表示对齐。在具有挑战性的混合动作基准测试中，CHDP 的成功率比最先进的方法提高了多达 19.3%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了协同混合扩散策略（CHDP）框架，用于解决参数化/混合动作空间中的强化学习难题。CHDP将该问题视为完全合作博弈，利用离散和连续两个协同扩散策略分别处理相应空间，并通过条件机制建模其依赖性。为了避免更新冲突，采用顺序更新机制；为了提升在高维离散空间中的扩展性，引入了低维码本嵌入和基于Q函数的引导对齐机制。实验表明，CHDP在混合动作基准测试中相比现有SOTA方法成功率提升达19.3%。
AI.keywords: 混合动作空间 (Hybrid Action Space), 扩散策略 (Diffusion Policies), 强化学习 (Reinforcement Learning), 合作博弈 (Cooperative Game)
AI.comments:
创新性：该论文创新性地将混合动作空间优化问题转化为完全合作博弈，并结合了扩散模型强大的表达能力，提出了离散和连续扩散策略的协同架构。通过码本嵌入和Q函数引导，有效解决了高维离散空间的扩展性难题。
重要性：混合动作空间广泛存在于机器人和游戏AI等实际应用中，该研究为此类复杂决策问题提供了一种高效且高扩展性的新方案。
局限性：摘要中未提及计算开销，由于采用了双扩散模型及顺序更新机制，其训练和采样推理的计算复杂度可能会相对较高。

title: Analysing Differences in Persuasive Language in LLM-Generated Text: Uncovering Stereotypical Gender Patterns
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for everyday communication tasks, including drafting interpersonal messages intended to influence and persuade. Prior work has shown that LLMs can successfully persuade humans and amplify persuasive language. It is therefore essential to understand how user instructions affect the generation of persuasive language, and to understand whether the generated persuasive language differs, for example, when targeting different groups. In this work, we propose a framework for evaluating how persuasive language generation is affected by recipient gender, sender intent, or output language. We evaluate 13 LLMs and 16 languages using pairwise prompt instructions. We evaluate model responses on 19 categories of persuasive language using an LLM-as-judge setup grounded in social psychology and communication science. Our results reveal significant gender differences in the persuasive language generated across all models. These patterns reflect biases consistent with gender-stereotypical linguistic tendencies documented in social psychology and sociolinguistics.

title: Probing Multimodal Large Language Models on Cognitive Biases in Chinese Short-Video Misinformation
summary: Short-video platforms have become major channels for misinformation, where deceptive claims frequently leverage visual experiments and social cues. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, their robustness against misinformation entangled with cognitive biases remains under-explored. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework using a high-quality, manually annotated dataset of 200 short videos spanning four health domains. This dataset provides fine-grained annotations for three deceptive patterns-experimental errors, logical fallacies, and fabricated claims-each verified by evidence such as national standards and academic literature. We evaluate eight frontier MLLMs across five modality settings. Experimental results demonstrate that Gemini-2.5-Pro achieves the highest performance in the multimodal setting with a belief score of 71.5/100, while o3 performs the worst at 35.2. Furthermore, we investigate social cues that induce false beliefs in videos and find that models are susceptible to biases like authoritative channel IDs.

title: Clipped Affine Policy: Low-Complexity Near-Optimal Online Power Control for Energy Harvesting Communications over Fading Channels
summary: This paper studies online power control for battery-limited point-to-point energy harvesting communications over slow block-fading channels. A linear-policy-based approximation is developed for the relative-value function in the Bellman equation of the power control problem. This approximation leads to two fundamental parameterized clipped affine policies: an optimistic policy derived from a certainty-equivalence-type approximation and a robust policy derived from worst-case analysis. For independent and identically distributed energy arrivals and channel states, two families of power control schemes are developed based on the optimistic clipped affine (OCA) and robust clipped affine (RCA) policies, respectively. The proposed adaptive RCA policy based on reinforcement learning (RCA-RL) is further extended to address four scenarios with contextual information: one-step energy lookahead, one-step channel lookahead, one-step joint energy-channel lookahead, and Markov energy arrivals. Extensive simulation results show that the proposed schemes provide a favorable tradeoff between computational complexity and performance. The adaptive RCA policy based on the maximin optimal linear-policy-slope approximation (RCA-OLA-A) and the RCA-RL scheme achieve the best overall performance, while the RCA policy based on the maximin optimal linear policy (RCA-OL) is the best-performing closed-form policy. In particular, RCA-OLA-A, RCA-RL, and the aforementioned RCA-RL extensions achieve less than 2% performance loss relative to the optimal policy across a range of scenarios, consistently outperforming the considered benchmark approaches, including generic reinforcement learning baselines. The RCA-OL policy also performs well with less than 4% performance loss.

title: AdaJudge: Adaptive Multi-Perspective Judging for Reward Modeling
summary: Reward modeling is essential for aligning large language models with human preferences, yet predominant architectures rely on a static pooling strategy to condense sequences into scalar scores. This paradigm, however, suffers from two key limitations: a static inductive bias that misaligns with task-dependent preference signals, and a representational mismatch, as the backbone's optimization for generation leaves its representations ill-suited to fine-grained discrimination. To address this, we propose AdaJudge, a unified framework that jointly adapts representation and aggregation. AdaJudge first improves backbone representations into a discrimination-oriented space via gated refinement blocks. It then replaces the static readout with an adaptive multi-view pooling module, which dynamically routes and combines evidence. Extensive experiments on RM-Bench and JudgeBench show that AdaJudge outperforms strong off-the-shelf reward models and traditional pooling baselines.

title: SEEK: Steering LLM Reasoning for RAG via Internal Reasoning Sketches
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge into the generation process. Benefiting from the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, existing methods have leveraged such capabilities to enable iterative knowledge acquisition and accumulation, thereby better supporting answer generation. However, as the reasoning trajectory grows, the accumulated knowledge and previously generated queries may interfere with subsequent retrieval decisions, resulting in sub-queries with repetitive intents and redundant knowledge acquisition. To address this issue, we propose SEEK, a sketch-guided knowledge acquisition framework for RAG. SEEK first prompts the LLM to construct a structured steering sketch for the given question. It consists of multiple groups of steering gists, with each gist followed by a slot for knowledge filling. Guided by these steering gists, SEEK iteratively retrieves and refines knowledge, and fills the corresponding slots to complete the sketch. The completed sketch is then used as contextual input for final answer generation. Experimental results show that SEEK achieves better performance than baseline models across multiple tasks. Further analyses demonstrate that SEEK can generate more diverse sub-queries, reduce redundant retrieval, and achieve a better balance between external knowledge utilization and internal knowledge conflict mitigation. All codes are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/PAGER.

AI.title_translation: SEEK：通过内部推理草图引导RAG中的大语言模型推理
AI.tldr: SEEK是一个为RAG设计的草图引导知识获取框架，通过预先构建包含知识槽位的结构化引导草图，引导LLM进行高效、非重复的迭代检索与知识填充。
AI.motivation: 在迭代式的检索增强生成（RAG）中，随着推理轨迹的增长，已累积的知识和先前生成的查询可能会干扰后续的检索决策，导致产生具有重复意图的子查询以及冗余的知识获取。
AI.method: 提出SEEK框架：首先提示LLM为给定问题构建一个结构化的引导草图（由多组引导要点及对应的知识填充槽位组成）；然后，在引导要点的指引下，迭代检索并提炼知识，填充相应槽位以完成草图；最后，将完成的草图作为上下文输入，用于生成最终答案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SEEK在多个任务上的表现优于基线模型。分析表明，它能够生成更多样化的子查询，减少冗余检索，并能更好地平衡外部知识利用与内部知识冲突。
AI.conclusion: SEEK通过结构化的推理草图，有效地指导了RAG中的知识获取过程，减少了冗余检索，并在多项任务上提升了LLM的生成表现。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识融入生成过程来增强大语言模型（LLM）。得益于LLM的推理能力，现有方法利用这些能力来实现迭代的知识获取和积累，从而更好地支持答案生成。然而，随着推理轨迹的增长，积累的知识和先前生成的查询可能会干扰后续的检索决策，导致产生具有重复意图的子查询和冗余的知识获取。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SEEK，一个用于RAG的草图引导知识获取框架。SEEK首先提示LLM为给定的问题构建一个结构化的引导草图。它由多组引导要点组成，每个要点后面跟着一个用于知识填充的槽位。在这些引导要点的指导下，SEEK迭代地检索和提炼知识，并填充相应的槽位以完成草图。完成的草图随后被用作最终答案生成的上下文输入。实验结果表明，SEEK在多个任务上的表现优于基线模型。进一步的分析表明，SEEK能够生成更多样化的子查询，减少冗余检索，并在外部知识利用与内部知识冲突缓解之间取得更好的平衡。所有代码均可在 https://github.com/OpenBMB/PAGER 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对RAG在多轮迭代检索中容易出现重复查询和冗余知识获取的问题，提出了SEEK框架。该框架通过让LLM预先生成一个包含引导要点和待填充槽位的结构化推理草图，引导系统进行有序的迭代检索与知识填充，最后利用填充完整的草图生成最终答案，从而提高了检索效率和生成质量。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 大语言模型, 推理草图, 知识获取, 迭代检索
AI.comments: 该论文切中了多轮RAG中常见的“检索漂移”和“信息冗余”痛点。通过引入“草图（Sketch）”这一概念，将全局推理规划与具体的知识检索解耦，既发挥了LLM的规划能力，又规范了后续的局部检索行为。这种“先规划、后填空、再生成”的范式在解决复杂多步推理问题时非常具有启发性，且开源代码进一步提升了其应用价值。

title: COMPOSE: Hypergraph Cover Optimization for Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: 3D human pose estimation from sparse multi-view camera rigs is an essential task for numerous applications, including action recognition, sports analysis, and human-robot interaction. While learned methods dominate the field on benchmarks, they require large annotated datasets; training-free optimization-based methods remain promising as they circumvent 3D supervision by solving a correspondence problem across views from 2D detections. Existing combinatorial formulations rely on pairwise associations to model this correspondence problem and enforce global consistency across views only as a downstream constraint. However, reconciling locally plausible pairwise matches becomes brittle under occlusion and noisy detections, where local errors propagate globally. We propose COMPOSE, which recasts multi-view 3D human pose estimation as a weighted exact-cover optimization over a hypergraph of person hypotheses. Our formulation replaces pairwise association and post-hoc consistency enforcement with a single global combinatorial objective. To address the exponentially large candidate space, we introduce a geometric pruning strategy alongside two complementary solvers: an exact Integer Linear Programming formulation and a scalable relaxation via Belief Propagation. Without any 3D supervision, COMPOSE improves average precision by up to 31 points over the best optimization-based method and 13 points over self-supervised learned methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of higher-order combinatorial association for training-free multi-view 3D human pose estimation.

AI.title_translation: COMPOSE：用于多视角三维人体姿态估计的超图覆盖优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了COMPOSE，一种无需3D监督的多视角3D人体姿态估计方法，通过将该任务建模为超图上的加权精确覆盖优化，有效解决了传统成对关联方法中局部误差全局传播的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的免训练多视角3D人体姿态估计方法通常依赖于成对关联（pairwise associations），且仅在下游步骤中强制执行全局一致性。这种方法在存在遮挡和噪声检测时非常脆弱，局部匹配错误极易传播至全局。因此，需要一种能够直接进行全局组合优化的方法来解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出COMPOSE方法，将多视角3D人体姿态估计重构为人体假设超图上的加权精确覆盖优化（weighted exact-cover optimization）问题。为了应对指数级庞大的候选空间，引入了几何剪枝策略，并设计了两种互补的求解器：精确的整数线性规划（ILP）公式和通过置信度传播（BP）实现的可扩展松弛求解。
AI.result: 在无需任何3D监督的情况下，COMPOSE方法相比于最先进的优化方法，平均精度（AP）提升了多达31个百分点；相比于自监督学习方法，平均精度提升了13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了高阶组合关联在免训练的多视角3D人体姿态估计中的有效性，展示了通过单一全局组合目标替代传统的成对关联和事后一致性约束的优越性。
AI.translation: 从稀疏的多视角相机阵列进行三维人体姿态估计是许多应用（包括动作识别、运动分析和人机交互）中的一项关键任务。虽然基于学习的方法在基准测试中占据主导地位，但它们需要大量的标注数据集；而无需训练的、基于优化的方法通过从2D检测中解决跨视角对应问题来规避3D监督，因此仍具前景。现有的组合公式依赖于成对关联来建模这种对应问题，并且仅将全局一致性作为下游约束来强制执行。然而，在遮挡和噪声检测下，协调局部合理的成对匹配会变得非常脆弱，局部误差会向全局传播。我们提出了COMPOSE，它将多视角3D人体姿态估计重构为人体假设超图上的加权精确覆盖优化。我们的公式用单一的全局组合目标取代了成对关联和事后一致性强制执行。为了解决指数级庞大的候选空间，我们引入了一种几何剪枝策略以及两种互补的求解器：精确的整数线性规划公式和通过置信度传播实现的具有可扩展性的松弛求解。在没有任何3D监督的情况下，COMPOSE相比于最佳优化方法将平均精度提高了多达31个百分点，相比于自监督学习方法提高了13个百分点，证明了高阶组合关联在免训练多视角3D人体姿态估计中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为COMPOSE的免训练多视角3D人体姿态估计方法。该方法将姿态估计问题重新表述为超图上的加权精确覆盖优化问题，从而用单一的全局组合目标取代了传统的成对关联和事后一致性约束。结合几何剪枝策略、整数线性规划以及置信度传播求解器，COMPOSE在无3D监督的条件下大幅提升了估计精度。
AI.keywords: 多视角3D人体姿态估计, 超图精确覆盖优化, 整数线性规划, 置信度传播, 免训练方法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统的多视角匹配问题从脆弱的成对关联（pairwise）升级为基于超图的全局组合优化（hypergraph exact-cover），这从根本上抑制了局部匹配误差的全局传播。其引入的几何剪枝和双求解器（ILP与BP）设计兼顾了精确度与计算效率。其局限性可能在于，作为一种非训练的几何优化方法，其性能仍高度依赖于前端2D检测器的质量，且在大规模场景下超图的构建和求解复杂度可能较高。

title: Optimal error estimates for a discontinuous Galerkin method on curved boundaries with polygonal meshes
summary: We consider a discontinuous Galerkin method for the numerical solution of boundary value problems in two-dimensional domains with curved boundaries. A key challenge in this setting is the potential loss of convergence order due to approximating the physical domain by a polygonal mesh. Unless boundary conditions can be accurately transferred from the true boundary to the computational one, such geometric approximation errors generally lead to suboptimal convergence. To overcome this limitation, a higher-order strategy based on polynomial reconstruction of boundary data was introduced for classical finite element methods in [31, 32] and in the finite volume context in [8, 14]. More recently, this approach was extended to discontinuous Galerkin methods in [35], leading to the DG-ROD method, which restores optimal convergence rates on polygonal approximations of domains with curved boundaries. In this work, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the DG-ROD method, establishing existence and uniqueness of the discrete solution and deriving error estimates for a two-dimensional linear advection-diffusion-reaction problem with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions on both convex and non-convex domains. Following and extending techniques from classical finite element methods [32], we prove that, under suitable regularity assumptions on the exact solution, the DG-ROD method achieves optimal convergence despite polygonal approximations. Finally, we illustrate and confirm the theoretical results with a numerical benchmark considering triangular meshes

AI.title_translation: 弯曲边界多边形网格上的间断伽辽金方法的最佳误差估计
AI.tldr: 该研究对DG-ROD方法进行了理论分析，证明了即使在弯曲边界的多边形近似下，该方法也能实现最优收敛。
AI.motivation: 在具有弯曲边界的二维区域上数值求解边值问题时，使用多边形网格近似物理区域可能导致收敛阶数损失。需要一种方法来克服这种几何近似误差。
AI.method: 对DG-ROD方法进行了理论分析，建立了离散解的存在唯一性，并推导了线性对流-扩散-反应问题的误差估计。该方法基于多项式重构边界数据。
AI.result: DG-ROD方法在处理弯曲边界的多边形近似时，在适当的正则性假设下，实现了最优收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为DG-ROD方法提供了严格的理论分析，证明了其在处理弯曲边界和多边形网格时的最优收敛性，并通过数值算例进行了验证。
AI.translation: 我们考虑在具有弯曲边界的二维区域中使用间断伽辽金方法进行边值问题的数值求解。在此场景下的一个关键挑战是由于使用多边形网格近似物理区域而可能导致的收敛阶数损失。除非能够将边界条件从真实边界准确地传递到计算边界，否则这种几何近似误差通常会导致次优收敛。为了克服这一限制，在经典有限元方法[31, 32]和有限体积方法[8, 14]的背景下，引入了一种基于边界数据多项式重构的高阶策略。最近，这种方法被扩展到间断伽辽金方法[35]，产生了DG-ROD方法，该方法在具有弯曲边界区域的多边形近似上恢复了最优收敛率。在本工作中，我们对DG-ROD方法进行了严格的理论分析，建立了离散解的存在唯一性，并推导了在凸形和非凸形区域上具有齐次狄利克雷边界条件的二维线性对流-扩散-反应问题的误差估计。遵循并扩展了经典有限元方法[32]的技术，我们证明了在精确解具有适当正则性假设的情况下，DG-ROD方法尽管存在多边形近似，仍能实现最优收敛。最后，我们通过考虑三角形网格的数值基准来说明和证实了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本研究对用于求解具有弯曲边界的二维区域边值问题的DG-ROD方法进行了理论分析。该方法通过多项式重构边界数据来克服多边形网格近似引起的几何误差，从而恢复最优收敛性。研究证明了该方法的离散解存在唯一性，并推导了线性对流-扩散-反应问题的误差估计，表明在适当正则性条件下可实现最优收敛，并通过数值实验进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 间断伽辽金方法, 弯曲边界, 多边形网格, 最优收敛, DG-ROD方法
AI.comments: 这项工作对间断伽涅尔金方法在处理复杂几何形状方面的收敛性分析做出了重要贡献，特别是通过DG-ROD方法克服了多边形网格近似引起的误差。理论分析严谨，并通过数值实验进行了验证，为该方法在实际应用中的可靠性提供了依据。然而，研究主要集中在线性对流-扩散-反应问题上，未来可以进一步探讨其在更复杂方程或高维问题上的适用性。

title: DialDefer: A Framework for Detecting and Mitigating LLM Dialogic Deference
comments: 10 pages main content, 7 figures, 35 pages total with appendix
summary: LLMs are increasingly used as third-party judges, yet their reliability when evaluating speakers in dialogue remains poorly understood. We show that LLMs judge identical claims differently depending on framing: the same content receives different verdicts when presented as a statement to verify ("Is this statement correct?") versus attributed to a speaker ("Is this speaker correct?"). We call this dialogic deference and introduce DialDefer, a framework for detecting and mitigating these framing-induced judgment shifts. Our Dialogic Deference Score (DDS) captures directional shifts that aggregate accuracy obscures. Across ten domains, 3k+ instances, and five models, conversational framing induces large shifts (mean|DDS|=15.9 percentage points (pp) across models, p < .0001) while accuracy remains stable (<2 pp), with effects amplifying 2--5x on naturalistic Reddit conversations. This effect is domain-dependent: a single model can shift toward disagreement (skepticism) on graduate-level science and toward agreement (deference) on social judgment. Ablations reveal that human-vs-LLM attribution drives the largest shifts (17.7 pp swing), suggesting models treat disagreement with humans as more costly than with AI. Mitigation attempts can reduce deference but over-correct into skepticism, revealing a calibration problem beyond accuracy optimization.
comment: 10 pages main content, 7 figures, 35 pages total with appendix

AI.title_translation: DialDefer：一种检测和缓解大型语言模型对话让步的框架
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在作为第三方裁判时存在对话让步问题，即它们会根据声明的呈现方式（是独立声明还是归属于某人）给出不同的判断。DialDefer框架通过对话让步得分（DDS）来量化这种现象，发现对话式框架会导致显著的判断偏移，尤其是在自然对话场景下，且这种偏移会因模型和领域而异。缓解策略可能导致过度修正。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作第三方裁判，但它们在对话中评估说话者的可靠性仍然知之甚少。本研究旨在揭示和解决LLM在对话评估中存在的“对话让步”现象，即LLM的判断会受到声明呈现方式的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DialDefer的框架，用于检测和缓解由对话框架引起的判断偏移。该框架引入了对话让步得分（DDS）来量化判断的定向偏移。通过在十个领域、3000多个实例和五个模型上进行实验来评估该框架，并进行了消融研究以确定驱动偏移的关键因素，同时尝试了缓解策略。
AI.result: 在十个领域、3000多个实例和五个模型上进行的研究表明，对话式框架会导致显著的判断偏移（平均绝对DDS为15.9个百分点），而准确性保持稳定（<2个百分点）。这种效应在自然生成的Reddit对话中会放大2-5倍。模型在科学领域倾向于表现出怀疑态度（不赞成），而在社会判断领域则倾向于表现出顺从态度（赞同）。将声明归因于人类而非AI会引起最大的判断偏移（17.7个百分点）。缓解策略虽然能减少让步，但可能过度修正，导致怀疑态度。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在对话评估中存在系统性的“对话让步”现象，这种现象受声明归属（尤其是与人类的对比）和领域的影响。目前的缓解策略在解决准确性问题的同时，也带来了校准问题，表明在优化LLM的判断时，需要超越简单的准确性指标。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作第三方裁判，但它们在评估对话中的说话者时的可靠性仍然知之甚少。我们发现，大型语言模型会根据表述方式对相同的声明做出不同的判断：当表述为需要验证的陈述（“这个陈述正确吗？”）时，与将其归因于某位说话者（“这位说话者正确吗？”）时，相同的内容会得到不同的判决。我们称之为对话让步，并引入了DialDefer框架来检测和缓解这些由表述引起的判断偏移。我们的对话让步得分（DDS）捕捉了准确性所掩盖的定向偏移。在十个领域、3000多个实例和五个模型中，对话式表述会引起显著的偏移（跨模型平均绝对DDS为15.9个百分点，p < .0001），而准确性保持稳定（<2个百分点），并且这种效应在自然生成的Reddit对话中会放大2-5倍。这种效应是领域相关的：单一模型可能在研究生级别的科学领域表现出转向不赞成的态度（怀疑），而在社会判断领域则表现出转向赞成的态度（顺从）。消融研究表明，人类与LLM的归属会引起最大的偏移（17.7个百分点的摆动），这表明模型认为与人类不一致比与AI不一致的代价更大。缓解尝试可以减少让步，但会过度修正导致怀疑，揭示了超越准确性优化之外的校准问题。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了DialDefer框架，用于检测和缓解大型语言模型（LLM）在对话评估中存在的“对话让步”现象。研究发现，LLM的判断会因声明是以独立陈述还是归属于某人而产生显著偏移，即使内容相同。该框架通过对话让步得分（DDS）量化了这种偏移，结果显示，对话式框架在不同模型和领域（尤其是在自然对话场景中）会导致判断发生较大变化，而准确性基本不受影响。研究还指出，将声明归因于人类而非AI会加剧这种偏移，并且当前的缓解方法可能导致过度修正。这项工作揭示了LLM在作为第三方裁判时的潜在偏见，并强调了在评估和优化其性能时需要考虑的校准问题。
AI.keywords: 对话让步, 大型语言模型, 第三方裁判, 框架, 评估偏差
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了大型语言模型在作为对话裁判时一个重要的、之前未被充分认识的偏见——“对话让步”。通过引入DialDefer框架和DDS指标，研究为量化和理解这种现象提供了一个有价值的工具。研究结果表明，LLM的判断不仅取决于内容的客观性，还受到表述方式和归属信息（特别是与人类的对比）的显著影响，这对于理解LLM在现实世界应用中的可靠性至关重要。然而，研究也指出了缓解策略的局限性，即可能导致过度修正，这表明在提高LLM的公平性和鲁棒性方面仍然存在挑战。未来的研究可以进一步探索这种现象的深层机制，并开发更有效的、能够实现良好校准的缓解技术。

title: Where to Touch, How to Contact: Hierarchical RL-MPC Framework for Geometry-Aware Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation
summary: A key challenge in contact-rich dexterous manipulation is the need to jointly reason over global geometry and nonsmooth contact dynamics. End-to-end policies bypass this complexity, but often require large amounts of data and transfer poorly from simulation to reality. We address the limitations with a simple insight: dexterous manipulation is inherently hierarchical--at a high level, a robot decides where to touch (geometry); at a low level it determines how to move the object through contact dynamics. Building on this insight, we propose a hierarchical RL--MPC framework in which a high-level reinforcement learning (RL) policy predicts a contact intention, a novel object-centric interface that specifies (i) an object-surface contact location and (ii) a post-contact object subgoal pose. Conditioned on the contact intention, a low-level contact-implicit model predictive control (MPC) optimizes local contact modes and real-time (re)plans through contact dynamics to generate robot actions that robustly move the object toward each subgoal. We evaluate the framework on non-prehensile tasks, including geometry-generalized pushing across diverse object shapes, pivoting/flipping-based object reorientation, and environment-assisted object repositioning. It achieves high success rate with substantially reduced data (10 times less than end-to-end baselines), highly robust performance, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

AI.title_translation: 触碰何处，如何接触：面向几何感知的长时域灵巧操作的层次化强化学习-模型预测控制框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种分层强化学习-模型预测控制（RL-MPC）框架，用于解决需要同时考虑全局几何和非光滑接触动力学的灵巧操作问题。高层RL策略预测接触意图（接触点和接触后的目标姿态），低层MPC基于此意图优化接触模式并实时重新规划，以实现鲁棒的对象操作。该方法在非抓取任务中表现出色，数据需求少，鲁棒性强，并实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统的端到端策略在处理接触丰富的灵巧操作时，需要大量数据且难以从仿真迁移到现实。该研究旨在克服这些局限性，利用灵巧操作固有的层次化特性。
AI.method: 提出一个分层RL-MPC框架。高层RL策略预测接触意图（包括接触位置和目标姿态），低层接触隐式MPC优化接触模式并实时重新规划以生成机器人动作。
AI.result: 该框架在非抓取任务（如跨几何形状的推挤、基于枢转/翻转的对象重定向、环境辅助的对象重新定位）中取得了高成功率，数据需求比端到端基线减少了10倍，表现出高度鲁棒性，并实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该分层RL-MPC框架能够有效解决接触丰富的灵巧操作问题，通过分离几何推理和接触动力学优化，提高了数据效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 接触丰富的灵巧操作的一个关键挑战在于需要同时推理全局几何和非光滑接触动力学。端到端策略绕过了这个复杂性，但通常需要大量数据，并且从仿真到现实的迁移效果不佳。我们通过一个简单的见解来解决这些局限性：灵巧操作本质上是分层的——在高层，机器人决定在哪里接触（几何）；在低层，它通过接触动力学来确定如何移动对象。基于这个见解，我们提出了一个分层强化学习-模型预测控制（RL-MPC）框架，其中一个高层强化学习（RL）策略预测接触意图，这是一个新颖的以对象为中心的接口，指定（i）一个对象-表面接触位置和（ii）一个接触后的对象子目标姿态。在接触意图的条件下，一个低层接触隐式模型预测控制（MPC）优化局部接触模式并通过接触动力学进行实时（重新）规划，以生成机器人动作，从而鲁棒地将对象移动到每个子目标。我们在非抓取任务上评估了该框架，包括跨越各种物体形状的几何泛化推挤、基于枢转/翻转的对象重定向以及环境辅助的对象重新定位。它以显着减少的数据（比端到端基线少10倍）实现了高成功率、高度鲁棒的性能以及零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种分层强化学习-模型预测控制（RL-MPC）框架，用于解决复杂的灵巧操作任务。该框架将操作分解为高层几何推理（决定接触点和目标姿态）和低层接触动力学控制（执行动作）。实验证明，该方法在多种非抓取任务中展现出高成功率、高鲁棒性，并显著减少了数据需求和实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
AI.keywords: 分层强化学习, 模型预测控制, 灵巧操作, 接触动力学, 几何推理
AI.comments: 该研究提出的分层RL-MPC框架在解决灵巧操作问题上具有创新性，通过将问题分解为几何和动力学两个层面，有效提高了数据效率和泛化能力。其接触意图接口的设计是一个亮点，使得高低层策略的协同更加明确。然而，MPC的计算成本和对接触动力学模型的精度要求可能是潜在的局限性。

title: LiQSS: Post-Transformer Linear Quantum-Inspired State-Space Tensor Networks for Real-Time 6G
summary: Proactive and agentic control in Sixth-Generation (6G) Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) requires control-grade prediction under stringent Near-Real-Time (Near-RT) latency and computational constraints. While Transformer-based models are effective for sequence modeling, their quadratic complexity limits scalability in Near-RT RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) analytics. This paper investigates a post-Transformer design paradigm for efficient radio telemetry forecasting. We propose a quantum-inspired many-body state-space tensor network that replaces self-attention with stable structured state-space dynamics kernels, enabling linear-time sequence modeling. Tensor-network factorizations in the form of Tensor Train (TT) / Matrix Product State (MPS) representations are employed to reduce parameterization and data movement in both input projections and prediction heads, while lightweight channel gating and mixing layers capture non-stationary cross-Key Performance Indicator (KPI) dependencies. The proposed model is instantiated as an agentic perceive-predict xApp and evaluated on a bespoke O-RAN KPI time-series dataset comprising 59,441 sliding windows across 13 KPIs, using Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) forecasting as a representative use case. Our proposed Linear Quantum-Inspired State-Space (LiQSS) model is 10.8x-15.8x smaller and approximately 1.4x faster than prior structured state-space baselines. Relative to Transformer-based models, LiQSS achieves up to a 155x reduction in parameter count and up to 2.74x faster inference, without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.

AI.title_translation: LiQSS：面向6G实时系统的后Transformer线性量子启发式状态空间张量网络
AI.tldr: LiQSS通过量子启发式张量网络替代Transformer的注意力机制，在6G近实时预测中实现了大幅度的模型压缩与加速，且不损失预测精度。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在6G近实时无线接入网（O-RAN）智能控制器中因其二次方复杂度而导致可扩展性受限，无法满足严苛的实时预测需求。
AI.method: 提出LiQSS模型，利用量子启发式多体状态空间张量网络替代自注意力机制，采用张量列（TT）/矩阵乘积态（MPS）分解进行参数压缩，并集成轻量级通道门控和混合层以捕捉KPI间的依赖关系。
AI.result: 相比Transformer，LiQSS参数量减少高达155倍，推理速度提升2.74倍；相比现有结构化状态空间基线，模型体积缩小10.8-15.8倍，速度提升约1.4倍，且未降低预测精度。
AI.conclusion: LiQSS模型通过结合状态空间动力学和张量网络压缩，在保持预测准确性的同时，显著降低了参数量和推理时延，是实现6G近实时智能控制器分析的高效解决方案。
AI.translation: 6G开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中的主动式代理控制需要在严格的近实时（Near-RT）延迟和计算约束下进行控制级预测。虽然基于Transformer的模型在序列建模方面很有效，但其二次方复杂度限制了其在近实时无线接入网智能控制器（RIC）分析中的可扩展性。本文研究了一种用于高效无线电遥测预测的后Transformer设计范式。我们提出了一种量子启发式多体状态空间张量网络，它用稳定的结构化状态空间动力学核取代了自注意力，实现了线性时间的序列建模。采用张量列（TT）/矩阵乘积态（MPS）形式的张量网络分解来减少输入投影和预测头的参数化及数据移动，同时利用轻量级通道门控和混合层来捕捉非平稳的跨关键绩效指标（KPI）依赖关系。所提出的模型被实例化为一个代理感知-预测xApp，并在一个包含13个KPI、59,441个滑动窗口的定制O-RAN KPI时间序列数据集上进行了评估，以参考信号接收功率（RSRP）预测作为代表性用例。我们提出的线性量子启发式状态空间（LiQSS）模型比现有的结构化状态空间基线小10.8-15.8倍，速度快约1.4倍。相对于基于Transformer的模型，LiQSS在不牺牲预测精度的情况下，参数量减少了多达155倍，推理速度提升了多达2.74倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LiQSS的后Transformer设计范式，用于6G网络中的高效遥测预测。通过使用量子启发式状态空间张量网络替代Transformer的自注意力机制，实现了线性时间复杂度的序列建模。该模型通过张量分解显著降低了参数量，并经过RSRP预测任务验证，在性能和效率上均优于传统Transformer及基线状态空间模型。
AI.keywords: 6G, O-RAN, 状态空间模型, 张量网络, 序列建模
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将量子启发式张量网络与结构化状态空间模型相结合，成功解决了Transformer在6G近实时RAN控制中计算复杂度过高的问题。其重要性在于为低延迟、轻量化的无线电遥测预测提供了一种高效方案，特别适合资源受限的边缘计算环境。限制在于其性能依赖于特定的KPI数据集，在更复杂或非平稳性极强的网络环境下的泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: E2Former-V2: On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention with Linear Activation Memory
summary: Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have become a widely used approach for modeling 3D atomistic systems. However, mainstream architectures face critical scalability bottlenecks due to the explicit construction of geometric features or dense tensor products on \textit{every} edge. To overcome this, we introduce \textbf{E2Former-V2}, a scalable architecture that integrates algebraic sparsity with hardware-aware execution. We first propose \textbf{E}quivariant \textbf{A}xis-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{S}parsification (EAAS). EAAS builds on Wigner-$6j$ convolution by exploiting an $\mathrm{SO}(3) \rightarrow \mathrm{SO}(2)$ change of basis to transform computationally expensive dense tensor contractions into efficient, sparse parity re-indexing operations. Building on this representation, we introduce \textbf{On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention}, a fully node-centric mechanism implemented via a custom fused Triton kernel. By eliminating materialized edge tensors and maximizing SRAM utilization, our kernel achieves a \textbf{20$\times$ improvement in TFLOPS} compared to standard implementations. Extensive experiments on the SPICE and OMol25 datasets demonstrate that E2Former-V2 maintains comparable predictive performance while notably accelerating inference. This work demonstrates that large equivariant transformers can be trained efficiently using widely accessible GPU platforms. The code is avalible at https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM/tree/e2formerv2.

AI.title_translation: E2Former-V2：具有线性激活内存的即时等变注意力
AI.tldr: E2Former-V2通过EAAS（等变轴对齐稀疏化）和即时等变注意力机制解决了现有图神经网络的可扩展性问题，实现了20倍的TFLOPS提升，同时保持了可比的预测性能，证明了在通用GPU上高效训练大型等变Transformer的可行性。
AI.motivation: 主流的等变图神经网络（EGNN）在处理3D原子系统中存在可扩展性瓶颈，因为它们需要在每条边上显式构建几何特征或进行密集的张量积。E2Former-V2旨在克服这一限制，实现更高效的模型。
AI.method: E2Former-V2引入了两种关键技术：1. 等变轴对齐稀疏化（EAAS），它利用Wigner-6j卷积和SO(3)到SO(2)基变换，将密集的张量收缩转化为稀疏的奇偶校验重新索引操作。2. 即时等变注意力，一种全节点中心机制，通过定制的Triton内核实现，消除了物化的边张量，最大化了SRAM利用率。
AI.result: E2Former-V2在SPICE和OMol25数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果显示其在预测性能上与标准实现相当，同时显著加快了推理速度，TFLOPS提升了20倍。
AI.conclusion: E2Former-V2成功地通过EAAS和即时等变注意力机制解决了EGNN的可扩展性问题，证明了在通用GPU上高效训练大型等变Transformer是可行的。
AI.translation: 等变图神经网络（EGNN）已成为模拟3D原子系统的常用方法。然而，由于在*每*条边上显式构建几何特征或进行密集张量积，主流架构面临着严重的可扩展性瓶颈。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了**E2Former-V2**，一种集成了代数稀疏性和硬件感知执行的可扩展架构。我们首先提出了**E**quivariant **A**xis-**A**ligned **S**parsification（EAAS）。EAAS基于Wigner-6j卷积，通过利用$	extrm{SO}(3) ightarrow 	extrm{SO}(2)$基变换，将计算成本高昂的密集张量收缩转化为高效的稀疏奇偶校验重新索引操作。在此表示的基础上，我们引入了**即时等变注意力**，一种通过定制的Triton内核实现的全节点中心机制。通过消除物化的边张量和最大化SRAM利用率，我们的内核与标准实现相比，TFLOPS提升了**20倍**。在SPICE和OMol25数据集上的广泛实验表明，E2Former-V2在保持可比的预测性能的同时，显著加快了推理速度。这项工作表明，可以使用广泛可用的GPU平台高效地训练大型等变Transformer。代码可在https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM/tree/e2formerv2获取。
AI.summary: E2Former-V2是一种创新的、可扩展的等变图神经网络架构，它通过引入等变轴对齐稀疏化（EAAS）和即时等变注意力机制，解决了现有模型在处理3D原子系统时的可扩展性瓶颈。EAAS利用基变换将计算密集型操作转化为稀疏操作，而即时等变注意力则通过优化的Triton内核减少了内存开销和计算量，实现了20倍的TFLOPS提升。实验证明，E2Former-V2在保持预测精度的同时大幅提高了推理速度，并证明了在通用GPU上高效训练大型等变Transformer的可行性。
AI.keywords: 等变图神经网络, E2Former-V2, 即时等变注意力, EAAS, 可扩展性
AI.comments: 这项研究通过EAAS和即时等变注意力机制，有效地解决了现有EGNN模型在可扩展性方面存在的关键问题。20倍的TFLOPS提升和在通用GPU上的高效训练能力，使得在更广泛的硬件平台上应用复杂的等变模型成为可能。然而，需要进一步评估其在不同类型和规模的3D原子系统上的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: Numerical Study of Dissipative Weak Solutions for the Euler Equations of Gas Dynamics
summary: We study dissipative weak (DW) solutions of the Euler equations of gas dynamics using the first-, second-, third-, fifth-, seventh-, and ninth-order local characteristic decomposition-based central-upwind (LCDCU), low-dissipation central-upwind (LDCU), and viscous finite volume (VFV) methods, whose higher-order extensions are obtained via the framework of the alternative weighted essentially non-oscillatory (A-WENO) schemes. These methods are applied to several benchmark problems, including several two-dimensional Riemann problems and a Kelvin-Helmholtz instability test. The numerical results demonstrate that for methods converging only weakly in space and time, the limiting solutions are generalized DW solutions, approximated in the sense of ${\cal K}$-convergence and dependent on the numerical scheme. For all of the studied methods, we compute the associated Young measures and compare the DW solutions using entropy production and energy defect criteria.

AI.title_translation: 欧拉气体动力学方程耗散弱解的数值研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用多种高精度数值方法（包括LCDCU、LDCU和VFV方法，并结合A-WENO框架）求解欧拉气体动力学方程的耗散弱解。通过在二维黎曼问题和凯尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性测试等基准问题上的数值模拟，研究表明，对于在空间和时间上仅弱收敛的方法，其极限解是广义的耗散弱解，并且依赖于数值格式。文章还计算了相关的Young测度和比较了不同耗散弱解在熵产生和能量亏损标准下的表现。
AI.motivation: 研究欧拉气体动力学方程的耗散弱解，探索不同高精度数值方法的适用性和解的性质。
AI.method: 使用一阶、二阶、三阶、五阶、七阶和九阶局部特征分解中心-上风（LCDCU）、低耗散中心-上风（LDCU）以及粘性有限体积（VFV）方法，并利用A-WENO框架获得高阶格式。将这些方法应用于二维黎曼问题和凯尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性测试。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，对于在空间和时间上仅弱收敛的方法，其极限解是广义的耗散弱解，并且其近似满足${\cal K}$-收敛性，同时解的性质依赖于所使用的数值格式。对所有研究的方法，计算了相关的Young测度，并根据熵产生和能量亏损标准比较了耗散弱解。
AI.conclusion: 对于在空间和时间上仅弱收敛的数值方法，其极限解是广义的耗散弱解，并且该解满足${\cal K}$-收敛性，同时解的性质依赖于数值格式。通过熵产生和能量亏损标准可以比较不同耗散弱解的特性。
AI.translation: 我们使用一阶、二阶、三阶、五阶、七阶和九阶局部特征分解中心-上风（LCDCU）、低耗散中心-上风（LDCU）以及粘性有限体积（VFV）方法，并通过替代加权本质上非振荡（A-WENO）格式框架获得这些方法的高阶扩展，来研究气体动力学欧拉方程的耗散弱（DW）解。将这些方法应用于几个基准问题，包括几个二维黎曼问题和凯尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性测试。数值结果表明，对于仅在空间和时间上弱收敛的方法，极限解是广义的DW解，并且以${\cal K}$-收敛的意义上近似，同时依赖于数值格式。对于所有研究的方法，我们计算了相关的Young测度，并使用熵产生和能量亏损标准比较了DW解。
AI.summary: 本文采用多种高精度数值方法（LCDCU、LDCU、VFV结合A-WENO框架）研究了气体动力学欧拉方程的耗散弱解。通过二维黎曼问题和凯尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性测试的数值模拟，发现弱收敛格式的极限解是依赖于格式的${\cal K}$-收敛的广义耗散弱解。文章还通过熵产生和能量亏损标准对这些解进行了比较。
AI.keywords: 耗散弱解, 欧拉方程, 数值方法, A-WENO, 局部特征分解中心-上风
AI.comments: 该研究通过数值方法深入探讨了欧拉方程耗散弱解的性质，特别是不同数值格式对解的影响。研究结果强调了数值格式在弱解近似中的重要性，并引入了熵产生和能量亏损等判据来表征解的特性，具有一定的理论和应用价值。然而，对于实际物理问题的普适性以及不同格式在计算效率和精度上的权衡，可能需要进一步的分析。

title: Persistent Permutability in Choice Petri Nets
summary: Persistence is a strong, global, behavioural property of a Petri net, meaning that no activity can disable a different activity. Persistent permutability is a weaker property, pertaining to individual interleavings of a Petri net and stating that a non-persistent sequence can be permuted into a persistent one. We identify Petri net classes for which persistent permutability already suffices to imply overall persistence. These classes generalise free-choice nets and are related to Petri's concept of ``confusion'', while they are distinguished from each other by diverse restrictions on the choice structure of a net. We prove Ochmanski's conjecture to be correct for these classes.

AI.title_translation: 选择Petri网中的持久置换性
AI.tldr: 持久置换性是Petri网中的一种行为属性，在某些类别的Petri网中，它足以保证整体持久性，并可用于证明Ochmanski猜想。
AI.motivation: 研究持久置换性在Petri网中的作用，特别是在哪些情况下它可以推导出整体持久性，并以此来证明Ochmanski猜想。
AI.method: 识别并定义具有持久置换性的Petri网类别，这些类别推广了自由选择网，并与“混淆”概念相关，但具有不同的选择结构限制。在这些类别中证明Ochmanski猜想。
AI.result: 证明了对于所识别的Petri网类别，持久置换性足以推导出整体持久性，并证明了Ochmanski猜想在这些类别中是正确的。
AI.conclusion: Ochmanski猜想在所研究的推广了自由选择网的Petri网类别中被证明是正确的，这些类别的特点是持久置换性可以推导出整体持久性。
AI.translation: 持久性是Petri网的一种强全局行为属性，意味着 কোনো活动都不能禁用另一种活动。持久置换性是一种较弱的属性，涉及Petri网的个体交错，并指出非持久序列可以置换成持久序列。我们识别出Petri网的某些类别，在这些类别中，持久置换性足以推导出整体持久性。这些类别推广了自由选择网，并与Petri的“混淆”概念相关，但它们通过对网的选择结构的各种限制而相互区分。我们证明了Ochmanski猜想在这些类别中是正确的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Petri网中的持久置换性，这是一种较弱的行为属性，指出非持久序列可以被置换成持久序列。研究人员识别出了一类推广了自由选择网的Petri网，并证明了在这些网中，持久置换性足以保证整体持久性。此外，他们还证明了Ochmanski猜想在这些特定类别中是成立的。
AI.keywords: 持久性, 置换性, Petri网, 自由选择网, Ochmanski猜想
AI.comments: 该研究在Petri网理论领域做出了重要贡献，特别是在持久性属性的理解和应用方面。通过识别特定类别的Petri网，并证明持久置换性在此类网中的充分性，该工作不仅深化了对Petri网行为的认识，而且成功地解决了Ochmanski猜想的一个重要问题。研究方法具有理论深度，但其在实际应用中的普适性和效率有待进一步探讨。

title: Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning: Continual Learning in LLM Agents Without Gradient Updates
summary: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at general tasks, they inherently struggle with continual adaptation due to the frozen weights after deployment. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) offers a solution but incurs prohibitive computational costs and the risk of catastrophic forgetting. We introduce Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL), a training-free framework that enables test-time policy optimization without any gradient updates. JitRL maintains a dynamic, non-parametric memory of experiences and retrieves relevant trajectories to estimate action advantages on-the-fly. These estimates are then used to directly modulate the LLM's output logits. We theoretically prove that this additive update rule is the exact closed-form solution to the KL-constrained policy optimization objective. Extensive experiments on WebArena and Jericho demonstrate that JitRL establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods. Crucially, JitRL outperforms the performance of computationally expensive fine-tuning methods (e.g., WebRL) while reducing monetary costs by over 30 times, offering a scalable path for continual learning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/liushiliushi/JitRL.

AI.title_translation: 即时强化学习：无需梯度更新的LLM代理持续学习
AI.tldr: JitRL通过在推理时利用记忆检索实时调整LLM输出，在无需微调的情况下实现了高效、低成本的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在部署后权重通常被冻结，难以进行持续适应。传统的强化学习方法虽然可以解决该问题，但存在计算成本高昂且容易出现灾难性遗忘的风险。
AI.method: 提出Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL)框架。该方法维护一个动态的非参数经验内存，在推理阶段检索相关轨迹以实时估计动作优势，并直接利用这些估计值调整LLM的输出逻辑值（logits），从而在无需梯度更新的情况下优化策略。
AI.result: 在WebArena和Jericho数据集上的实验表明，JitRL不仅在无训练方法中达到领先水平，甚至超过了昂贵的微调方法（如WebRL），同时成本降低了30倍以上。
AI.conclusion: JitRL通过无需梯度的实时策略优化，在大幅降低成本的同时实现了优于微调方法的持续学习效果，证明了在LLM代理中实现高效持续学习的可行性。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）代理在通用任务中表现出色，但由于部署后权重的冻结，它们在持续适应方面存在固有的困难。传统的强化学习（RL）提供了一种解决方案，但会带来昂贵的计算成本和灾难性遗忘的风险。我们引入了即时强化学习（JitRL），这是一个无需训练的框架，无需任何梯度更新即可实现测试时的策略优化。JitRL维护一个动态的、非参数的经验内存，并检索相关的轨迹以即时估计动作优势。这些估计值随后被用于直接调节LLM的输出逻辑值（logits）。我们在理论上证明了这种加性更新规则是KL约束策略优化目标的确切闭式解。在WebArena和Jericho上的广泛实验表明，JitRL在无需训练的方法中建立了新的最先进水平。至关重要的是，JitRL的表现优于计算成本高昂的微调方法（如WebRL），同时将货币成本降低了30倍以上，为持续学习代理提供了一条可扩展的路径。代码已在 https://github.com/liushiliushi/JitRL 提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了JitRL（即时强化学习）框架，这是一种无需梯度更新的持续学习方法。它通过动态存储和检索经验来实时估计动作优势，并直接调整LLM的输出以优化策略。该方法在保证高性能的同时，显著降低了计算成本并解决了灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型代理, 持续学习, 无梯度更新, 即时强化学习, 策略优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种极具创新性的无需微调的强化学习框架，通过无需梯度更新的方式实现了LLM代理的持续学习。其核心优势在于极大地降低了计算成本，同时规避了灾难性遗忘问题，并从理论上证明了其更新规则的有效性，为实际应用中的持续学习提供了高效、可扩展的路径。

title: Unified Regularization of 2D Singular Integrals for Axisymmetric Galerkin BEM in Eddy-Current Evaluation
summary: This paper presents an axisymmetric Galerkin boundary element method (BEM) for modeling eddy-current interactions between excitation coils and conductive objects. The formulation derives boundary integral equations from the Stratton-Chu representation for the azimuthal component of the vector potential in both air and conductive regions. The central contribution is a unified regularization framework for the two-dimensional (2D) singular integrals arising in Galerkin BEM. This framework handles both logarithmic and Cauchy singularities through a common set of integral transformations, eliminating the need for case-by-case analytical singularity extraction and enabling straightforward numerical quadrature. The regularization and quadrature stability are proved and verified numerically. The method is validated on several representative axisymmetric geometries, including cylindrical, conical, and spherical shells. Numerical experiments demonstrate consistently high accuracy and computational efficiency over the tested frequency interval and coil lift-off distances. The results confirm that the proposed axisymmetric Galerkin BEM, combined with the integral transformation technique, provides a robust and efficient framework for axisymmetric eddy-current nondestructive evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 涡流检测中轴对称Galerkin边界元法二维奇异积分的统一正则化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一的正则化方法来处理轴对称边界元法中的奇异积分，简化了涡流检测的数值建模过程，并提高了计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的涡流检测建模中，轴对称Galerkin边界元法处理奇异积分时通常需要复杂的逐案解析提取，限制了算法的通用性和易用性。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的正则化框架，利用积分变换处理2D奇异积分（对数及柯西奇异性），并将其应用于轴对称Galerkin边界元法中，通过数值求积进行求解。
AI.result: 通过数值实验验证了该方法在多种轴对称几何形状（圆柱、圆锥、球壳）下的高精度和高计算效率，且证明了正则化和求积的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种高效、鲁棒的轴对称Galerkin边界元法，通过统一的正则化框架成功解决了奇异积分问题，适用于涡流无损检测。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种轴对称Galerkin边界元法（BEM），用于模拟激励线圈与导电物体之间的涡流相互作用。该公式从空气和导电区域矢量势的方位角分量的Stratton-Chu表示中推导边界积分方程。主要贡献是为Galerkin BEM中出现的二维（2D）奇异积分提供了一个统一的正则化框架。该框架通过一套通用的积分变换处理对数奇异性和柯西奇异性，消除了逐案分析提取奇异性的需要，并实现了直接的数值求积。证明并数值验证了正则化和求积的稳定性。该方法在几种典型的轴对称几何形状上进行了验证，包括圆柱、圆锥和球壳。数值实验表明，在测试的频率间隔和线圈提离距离范围内，该方法具有始终如一的高精度和计算效率。结果证实，所提出的轴对称Galerkin BEM与积分变换技术相结合，为轴对称涡流无损检测提供了一个稳健且高效的框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于涡流检测的轴对称Galerkin边界元法，其核心创新在于一套统一的二维奇异积分正则化框架。该框架通过积分变换处理对数和柯西奇异性，无需针对性解析提取，提升了数值计算的稳定性和效率，并在多种典型几何结构中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 轴对称Galerkin边界元法, 涡流检测, 奇异积分, 正则化, 数值积分
AI.comments: 该论文通过统一的正则化框架解决了轴对称Galerkin边界元法中奇异积分处理的复杂性，显著简化了算法的实现难度，具有很高的工程应用价值。其主要创新在于将对数奇异性和柯西奇异性统一处理，避免了繁琐的解析提取过程。

title: Reformulating Energy Storage Capacity Accreditation Problem with Marginal Reliability Impact
summary: To enhance the efficiency of capacity markets, many electricity markets in the U.S. are adopting or planning to implement marginal capacity accreditation reforms. This paper provides new insights into energy storage capacity accreditation using Marginal Reliability Impact (MRI). We reformulate the commonly used reliability-based storage dispatch model as an optimization problem, enabling direct calculation of the MRI from the Lagrange multipliers, rather than using brute-force perturbation analysis. The analysis demonstrates that the EUE is a piecewise linear function and the storage MRI retains a non-negative property across various system scenarios. We further explore the influence of qualified capacity (QC), storage dispatch rules, and other key factors on storage accreditation, providing practical insights for system operators. Additionally, comparisons of storage capacity accreditation under different reliability criteria offer valuable guidance for policymakers in setting future standards. Numerical results from a modified California system validate our findings and highlight several important phenomena associated with the MRI-based accreditation scheme.

AI.title_translation: 基于边际可靠性影响的储能容量认证问题重构
AI.tldr: 本文通过重构优化模型，利用拉格朗日乘子直接计算储能的边际可靠性影响，大幅提升了电力市场中储能容量认证的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 为了提升电力市场效率，解决现有储能容量认证方法计算复杂的问题，并为容量市场改革提供更科学的认证框架。
AI.method: 将基于可靠性的储能调度模型重构为优化问题，通过拉格朗日乘子直接计算边际可靠性影响（MRI），替代了传统的暴力扰动分析法。
AI.result: 证明了预期缺电量（EUE）是分段线性函数，储能MRI在不同系统场景下保持非负性；通过加州电力系统算例验证了该方法的有效性，并揭示了合格容量（QC）和调度规则对认证结果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于拉格朗日乘子的MRI计算方法，不仅提升了储能容量认证的计算效率，还为电力市场容量机制的设计提供了重要的理论依据和实践指导。
AI.translation: 为了提高容量市场的效率，美国许多电力市场正在采用或计划实施边际容量认证改革。本文利用边际可靠性影响（MRI）为储能容量认证提供了新的见解。我们将常用的基于可靠性的储能调度模型重构为一个优化问题，从而能够直接从拉格朗日乘子计算MRI，而不是使用暴力扰动分析。分析表明，预期缺电量（EUE）是一个分段线性函数，且储能MRI在各种系统场景中保持非负性。我们进一步探讨了合格容量（QC）、储能调度规则及其他关键因素对储能认证的影响，为系统运营商提供了实践见解。此外，在不同可靠性标准下对储能容量认证的比较，为政策制定者设定未来标准提供了宝贵指导。基于改进的加州系统的数值结果验证了我们的发现，并强调了与基于MRI的认证方案相关的几个重要现象。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用拉格朗日乘子直接计算储能边际可靠性影响（MRI）的新框架，旨在优化电力市场中的储能容量认证过程，避免了传统扰动分析的繁琐计算，并为系统运营商和政策制定者提供了评估储能价值的实用工具。
AI.keywords: 储能, 容量认证, 边际可靠性影响, 电力市场, 拉格朗日乘子
AI.comments: 该论文通过利用拉格朗日乘子推导边际可靠性影响（MRI），巧妙地规避了计算量巨大的暴力扰动分析，为电力市场中储能容量的认证提供了高效且具备数学严谨性的新方法。其局限性在于主要基于特定系统模型进行验证，对极端场景下的普适性有待进一步探讨。

title: Enhancing Video Representations with Spatiotemporal-Semantic Residual to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
summary: Although Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved strong performance in video understanding, they still suffer from hallucination. Existing inference-time intervention methods usually modify videos under the contrastive decoding framework, but their heuristic designs bring limited improvements and increase inference latency. To address these issues, we propose ViSSRes, an inference-time intervention method that enhances video representations through a lightweight MLP-style network. Specifically, we use a contrastive random walk approach to characterize the spatiotemporal consistency of video representations, and introduce conditional mutual information to associate video representations with the model's semantic understanding. With the model backbone kept frozen, ViSSRes learns residuals for video representations and optimizes them from both spatiotemporal and semantic consistency perspectives. During inference, ViSSRes requires only a single forward pass and introduces no substantial additional inference cost.
